question: What is the meaning of prefabrication in relation to waste scenario technical data?
description: Prefabrication refers to the manufacturing of building components in a factory or other manufacturing site, which are then transported and assembled on-site. In relation to waste scenario technical data, prefabrication can significantly reduce waste generation during construction by ensuring precise manufacturing and minimizing errors or material wastage. Prefabricated components are often designed for easy assembly and disassembly, which can facilitate recycling and reuse of materials, thereby contributing to a more sustainable construction process. Prefabrication can also lead to more efficient use of materials and reduce the overall environmental impact of construction projects.
